facts.business: Yashraj Containeurs Ltd. is a company undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, with its Board of Directors' powers suspended and management vested in a Resolution Professional.

auditor.name: Satya Prakash Natani & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to inability to obtain sufficient audit evidence regarding trade receivables, investments, trade payables, borrowings, statutory dues, property plant & equipment, and other assets/liabilities under reconciliation in CIRP; Emphasis of Matter on CIRP admission, going concern basis despite accumulated losses of Rs. 14,803.49 Lakhs exceeding net worth.

key_risks: Powers of Board of Directors suspended
Accumulated losses of Rs. 14,803.49 Lakhs exceeding net worth
Going concern assumption dependent on CIRP outcome
Books of account and supporting documents under reconciliation/verification
Inability to assess expected credit loss/impairment of assets
Uncertainty regarding completeness and accuracy of liabilities and contingent liabilities
Claims submitted before Resolution Professional not yet admitted
facts.related_party_note: All Related Party Transactions during the year were at arm's length basis in the ordinary course of business. No materially significant RPTs with Promoters/Directors/KMP that could have potential conflict with company's interest. All RPTs placed before Audit Committee for approval. Details enumerated in Note No 31 of the Balance Sheet.
